show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/9G8cbU
show.description: Billionaire Ayush Damani survives being pushed off a 400-feet cliff by his girlfriend Richa and is rescued by Pearly, a simple mountain girl who has no idea who he is. With his memory gone, Ayush finds a new, peaceful life with her but danger still follows him. As greed, secrets, and betrayal rise again, Ayush doesn’t realise Pearly may also be hiding her own hunger for wealth… and the biggest shock of his life is yet to come.
